duplicate_notes: CONFIRMED CANONICAL (resolved 2026-07-11, reconciled with GSE168726's own record): direct GSM-level specimen-ID comparison (see gse-168726-methylation.json's duplicate_notes for the full evidence) proves GSE168726 and this record (GSE180061) contain the identical 121-sample Princess Margaret Cancer Center meningioma methylation cohort, deposited twice under two different GEO accessions. This accession (GSE180061, submitted 2021-07-13, public 2021-07-14) is the one actually linked to the published paper (Nassiri et al. Nature 2021, PMID 34433969) and is treated as the canonical/citable entry; GSE168726 (submitted 2021-03-11, public 2022-03-30, no linked PMID) is the redundant duplicate deposit. Not auto-merged into a single corpus record (both accessions are kept as separate entries per the corpus's dedup policy), but downstream analyses should avoid double-counting these 121 patients across both records.
